metadata.method: Four anonymous storyboard treatments scored individually against seven binary obligations. A one denotes visible evidence satisfying the stated obligation. Muted readability was assessed from scripted captions and durations. No rendered video, human or platform evaluation was involved.

criteria.criterion: Request-aligned CTA without an implied outcome
criteria.evidence: 4–6 s says “Yêu cầu báo giá”, which asks for a quote and promises no acceptance.
criteria.suggested_edit: Keep this line on the final RFQ button.

criteria.criterion: Approved product or service claim and qualifier in a shot
criteria.evidence: 2–4 s asks viewers to check specifications. No timed copy states which model has removable dividers.
criteria.suggested_edit: Show a divider lifted from the tray and caption it “Mẫu tiêu chuẩn có vách ngăn tháo rời.”

criteria.criterion: Price, selling unit, tax and minimum together in timed copy
criteria.evidence: No shot gives the amount, unit, tax status or minimum.
criteria.suggested_edit: Hold a card reading “Giá tham khảo 380.000 đồng/hộp, đã gồm thuế. Tối thiểu 5 hộp.”

criteria.criterion: Buyer preparation covers every required field meaning
criteria.evidence: None of the three captions names quantity in boxes, destination area or required delivery time.
criteria.suggested_edit: Before the CTA, show the form with “Chuẩn bị số hộp, địa bàn và thời điểm cần hàng.”

criteria.criterion: Every shot specifies a visible action or prop
criteria.evidence: All three picture fields are empty. The scope describes the intended storyboard but gives no shot-specific picture.
criteria.suggested_edit: Specify an overhead tray with screws in the opener, a close-up of the divider, a price card, three form labels and the final RFQ button.

criteria.criterion: Two usable opening lines with picture, body and CTA held constant
criteria.evidence: The variants array is empty. The product-name caption is the only opening.
criteria.suggested_edit: Over the same tray, test “Vít của hai công đoạn để đâu?” and “Vách khay này tháo ra được không?” Hold the remaining sequence and CTA fixed.

criteria.criterion: Timed, intelligible captions support a muted storyboard review
criteria.evidence: Timecodes are present, but the generic middle sentence repeats the product name inside a long instruction held for just two seconds. No specific condition is communicated.
criteria.suggested_edit: Shorten the middle copy to the verified feature, give the conditions a separate hold and replay both complete caption sequences muted.

criteria.criterion: Request-aligned CTA without an implied outcome
criteria.evidence: 21–25 s holds on an RFQ button. “Gửi yêu cầu báo giá theo hộp” accurately describes the action.
criteria.suggested_edit: Keep the four-second button hold.

criteria.criterion: Approved product or service claim and qualifier in a shot
criteria.evidence: 3–8 s shows the divider being removed and replaced. Its caption explicitly limits the feature to the standard Khe Gọn model.
criteria.suggested_edit: Keep “mẫu … tiêu chuẩn” in the same shot as the demonstration.

criteria.criterion: Price, selling unit, tax and minimum together in timed copy
criteria.evidence: 8–14 s contains 380.000 đồng, per box, tax included and an order from five boxes, all in one caption.
criteria.suggested_edit: Restore the approved “Giá tham khảo” wording on the price card so the amount reads as indicative.

criteria.criterion: Buyer preparation covers every required field meaning
criteria.evidence: 14–21 s names all three required meanings in the form shot: number of boxes, destination area and time goods are needed.
criteria.suggested_edit: Preserve those three form labels in frame.

criteria.criterion: Every shot specifies a visible action or prop
criteria.evidence: Each shot has a definite subject: overhead tray and parts, hand lifting the divider, price card beside the tray, form entries, then the RFQ button.
criteria.suggested_edit: Use distinguishable mock components so the first hook's two groups are visible on mute.

criteria.criterion: Two usable opening lines with picture, body and CTA held constant
criteria.evidence: Two short actual questions fit the same three-second opener. Only the {hook} slot changes and the rest of the shots, including CTA, are shared.
criteria.suggested_edit: Use the same framing, hand movement and caption placement for both exports.

criteria.criterion: Timed, intelligible captions support a muted storyboard review
criteria.evidence: Each of five shots has a timed caption, including a three-second opening line and six seconds for the price and minimum. The full sequence works in text alone.
criteria.suggested_edit: At export, verify the price and form labels remain legible on the intended phone display.

criteria.criterion: Request-aligned CTA without an implied outcome
criteria.evidence: 21–27 s says “Gửi đề nghị khảo sát” and holds on a request state. The follow-up clause describes calendar review without promising a booked slot.
criteria.suggested_edit: Use “Gửi đề nghị khảo sát” alone unless the team has confirmed the stated follow-up process.

criteria.criterion: Approved product or service claim and qualifier in a shot
criteria.evidence: 9–15 s shows a sample diagram marked “Minh họa”. The caption names the receiving-flow diagram and confines delivery to the survey session.
criteria.suggested_edit: Keep the illustration label visible alongside the scoped claim.

criteria.criterion: Price, selling unit, tax and minimum together in timed copy
criteria.evidence: 15–21 s gives 760.000 đồng per lượt, tax included and a minimum of one lượt in the same caption.
criteria.suggested_edit: Add “Giá tham khảo” to retain the approved status of the price.

criteria.criterion: Buyer preparation covers every required field meaning
criteria.evidence: 3–9 s asks for the receiving shift and location. 21–27 s shows both selections. Those correspond to site and receiving shift to observe.
criteria.suggested_edit: Keep the final form labels explicit: “Địa điểm” and “Ca nhận hàng cần quan sát”.

criteria.criterion: Every shot specifies a visible action or prop
criteria.evidence: The five shot descriptions specify a model and card, an arrow and waiting point, an illustrated diagram, a conditions card and a form showing site/shift selection.
criteria.suggested_edit: Keep the indicated waiting point clearly visible in the overhead framing.

criteria.criterion: Two usable opening lines with picture, body and CTA held constant
criteria.evidence: The two supplied questions use a single three-second model shot. The {hook} slot is the only copy that varies and the following four shots and CTA are shared.
criteria.suggested_edit: Use the same model, camera position and hold for each opener.

criteria.criterion: Timed, intelligible captions support a muted storyboard review
criteria.evidence: The opening gets three seconds and the following four captions each get six. The captions carry the required inputs, scoped deliverable, conditions and request even without narration.
criteria.suggested_edit: In the rendered proof, keep the diagram label and captions in separate parts of the frame.

criteria.criterion: Request-aligned CTA without an implied outcome
criteria.evidence: 4–6 s says “Đặt lịch”. With no request qualifier or pending-state picture, that wording suggests booking a slot.
criteria.suggested_edit: Use “Gửi đề nghị khảo sát” and hold on the request button.

criteria.criterion: Approved product or service claim and qualifier in a shot
criteria.evidence: No timed shot mentions handover of the receiving-flow diagram or limits it to the survey.
criteria.suggested_edit: Show an illustrative diagram with “Trong buổi khảo sát, Luồng Rõ bàn giao sơ đồ luồng nhận hàng.”

criteria.criterion: Price, selling unit, tax and minimum together in timed copy
criteria.evidence: The generic reference to conditions at 2–4 s gives none of the four commercial terms.
criteria.suggested_edit: Hold the caption “Giá tham khảo 760.000 đồng/lượt, đã gồm thuế. Tối thiểu 1 lượt.”

criteria.criterion: Buyer preparation covers every required field meaning
criteria.evidence: No caption tells the buyer to choose the site or receiving shift to observe.
criteria.suggested_edit: Show the two required selectors and caption “Chọn địa điểm và ca nhận hàng cần quan sát.”

criteria.criterion: Every shot specifies a visible action or prop
criteria.evidence: All three picture fields are empty, including the shot with the booking CTA.
criteria.suggested_edit: Write shots around a model receiving area, a hand tracing a diagram, a price card and a request form with both selectors.

criteria.criterion: Two usable opening lines with picture, body and CTA held constant
criteria.evidence: The variants array is empty. The single service name does not give a second executable opening.
criteria.suggested_edit: On the same model shot, try “Hàng đang chờ ở khâu nào?” and “Khảo sát xong, kho nhận được gì?” Use one body and request CTA.

criteria.criterion: Timed, intelligible captions support a muted storyboard review
criteria.evidence: The two-second middle caption repeats the full service name in a long general instruction. Its nominal timecode does not give a workable reading hold.
criteria.suggested_edit: Break out a short site/shift prompt, a scoped deliverable and a timed conditions card. Review at actual playback speed with sound off.
